item.title: Snow Peak × Pendleton Towel Blanket
item.description:
A collaboration with the legendary blanket maker, Pendleton Woolen Mills®, the SS25 Snow Peak x Pendleton Towel Blanket is a multifunctional accessory for use at home or the campfield. Crafted from thick loopback cotton, the unique sawtooth pattern is inspired by the scenery of the Ochoco Mountains in central Oregon, and features Snow Peak asterisks in two distinct colorways. The absorbent fabric is great as a beach or river towel, while the ultra-soft feel provides warmth and comfort as a blanket.

Variant:
Snow Peak × Pendleton Towel Blanket - BLUE / OS
Snow Peak × Pendleton Towel Blanket - OATMEAL / OS

item.title: Compact Mat Slim
item.description:
The Compact Mat Slim is a thick sleeping mat that can be rolled up and stored compactly when not in use. The mat features an integrated manual pump with a check valve, allowing it to be easily inflated without an electric pump. The Compact Mat Slim boasts an R-Value of 5.4, providing superior insulation for camping during all seasons. The mat is made from material designed to reduce noise when changing sleeping positions, providing a quieter sleeping environment, and features velcro tabs along each side that allow multiple mats to be connected.

Variant:
Compact Mat Slim

item.title: 2-Layer Tarp Pro.
item.description:
The 2-Layer Tarp Pro. is a heat-blocking tarp designed for temperature regulation in areas with direct sun exposure. With most tarps, the temperature beneath can become uncomfortable due to radiant, reflected, and convective heat, so the 2-Layer Tarp Pro. was designed to combat each of these factors with its materials and structure.


The outer tarp is made from a new woven twill fabric (SOLAMENT®) that absorbs visible light, ultraviolet, and near-infrared rays. The inner tarp reduces radiant heat, and its shape promotes air intake while blocking sunlight and reflected heat along the sides. The 2-layer structure creates exceptional air flow and efficiently releases heat from under the tarp.


Please note: the 2-Layer Tarp Pro. is designed to be used with 280cm Wing Poles (x2), 140cm Wing Poles (x2), and Solid Stake #40s (x8), sold separately.

Variant:
2-Layer Tarp Pro.

item.title: System Cooler 19
item.description:
The System Cooler 19 is a soft cooler with high insulation power. The cooler features an integrated heat shielding sheet and 20mm thick insulation, keeping the contents cold for up to two days at camp. The System Cooler 19 also features an interior mesh pocket for cooling packs, an adjustable and removable shoulder strap, a double-zippered closure with an extra-wide opening, and buckles on each side for securing the top panel.

Variant:
System Cooler 19

item.title: GigaPower Charger
item.description:
The GigaPower Charger is a wireless phone charger designed to be used with the GigaPower Battery. The phone holder piece can be adjusted to different angles, allowing your device to be used while charging. A locking knob secures the holder in your desired position.


Please note: This product must be used with the GigaPower Battery, which is not included.

Variant:
GigaPower Charger

item.title: Dog Ofuton Sleeping Bag L
item.description:
The Dog Ofuton Sleeping Bag L offers warmth and comfort for your campsite companion. Designed for medium to large pets, the sleeping bag can be adjusted to fit with zippers on either side. When not in use, the sleeping bag can be stored in the included drawstring storage sack.

Variant:
Dog Ofuton Sleeping Bag L

item.title: Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern
item.description:
Designed and made in Japan, the Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern is a versatile light. Use it at your desk or campsite table, or utilize the hanging hook for elevated illumination. The Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern features LED Candle Mode, which creates a soft flickering glow. Pair the Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern with the Lantern Pile Driver for elevated lighting.


The lantern also has an intelligent energy-saving Sleep Mode, so the light automatically turns off when the surrounding space is silent. Use the power button to turn the lantern on or off and to enter the different modes. The Hozuki Lantern is available in Twilight, Night Sky, or Morning Mist colors, and pairs well with the Daisy Chain. The Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern is powered by an integrated battery that can be charged with a USB C cable, sold separately.

Variant:
Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern - Twilight
Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern - Night Sky
Rechargeable Hozuki Lantern - Morning Mist

item.title: Soft Bucket 12
item.description:
The Soft Bucket 12 is a versatile three-gallon bucket for foraging mushrooms, carrying water, or harvesting berries. The Soft Bucket 12 features a waterproof coating and a durable carry strap. When not in use, it can be rolled up and secured with the integrated strap and buckle for easy storage. Pair the Soft Bucket 12 with the Soft Bucket 25 for a wash and rinse station.

Variant:
Soft Bucket 12

item.title: Soft Bucket 14
item.description:
The Soft Bucket 14 is a versatile 3.5-gallon bucket. Use it as a camp wash basin for dishes or store smaller camp accessories. The Soft Bucket 14 has reinforced corners and handles for easy carrying. Fold it down flat for compact storage when not in use. Pair the Soft Bucket 14 with the Soft Bucket 25 for a wash and rinse station.

Soft Bucket 14

When not in use, it can be rolled up and secured with the integrated strap and buckle for easy storage. Pair the Soft Bucket 25 with the Soft Bucket 14 for a wash and rinse station.

item.title: Land Nest Shelter Shield Roof
item.description:
The Land Nest Shield Roof is an additional environmental protection for the Land Nest Shelter. The roof provides UV and precipitaton protection.


Please note, the Shield Roof is not a standalone product and cannot be used on its own.

Variant:
Land Nest Shelter Shield Roof

item.title: Land Nest Shelter Mat & Sheet Set
item.description:
The Land Nest Shelter Mat & Sheet Set is designed to keep tents comfortable and clean. The floor sheet will keep dirt out of your tent, and the mat protects from the ground underneath. The Land Nest Shelter Mat & Sheet Set is lightweight and compact - an easy addition to your camp kit. Each purchase includes a carrying case. Pair the Land Nest Shelter Mat & Sheet Set with the Land Nest Shelter for a comfortable sleep.

Variant:
Land Nest Shelter Mat & Sheet Set

item.title: Land Nest Shelter
item.description:
The Land Nest Shelter is a beginner-level shelter with living and sleeping spaces, providing enough space for a family of four. Based on the design of the Land Nest Dome, the Land Nest Shelter has a symmetrical design and simple frame structure, making it easy to set up for campers of all experience levels. The inner tent can be removed to create a more spacious living area. The shelter material is designed with sun-blocking and temperature-regulating features, making it ideal for camping in any season.

Variant:
Land Nest Shelter

item.description:

The collapsible frame design reduces storage size and offers additional modularity, with interchangeable rails in three sizes.

item.title: Kaen Stove
item.description:
The Kaen Stove is a lightweight alcohol stove designed for cooking while enjoying the warmth and light of the fire. The central fuel reservoir can hold 80 ml of bioethanol fuel, offering up to 35 minutes of burn time. The trivets and frame can be disassembled and packed flat for easy storage and transportation.

Variant:

item.title: GigaPower Hanging Lantern
item.description:
The GigaPower Hanging Lantern is an LED lantern that can be used as the primary light source for your campsite or interior space. The lantern features a glass shade and a large light tube for 360° illumination, with a folding hanger that can also be used as a handle. Designed to have the look and feel of a gas lantern, the brightness can be fine-tuned with a knob on the side, and the light tube features a mesh pattern reminiscent of a lantern mantle.


Please Note: GigaPower Battery required for use, not included.

Variant:
GigaPower Hanging Lantern

item.title: GigaPower Tabletop Lantern
item.description:
The GigaPower Tabletop Lantern is a multi-purpose camp lantern. The lantern features white and colored LED lights within a cylindrical bulb for 360° illumination, with adjustable brightness controlled by a knob on the side. The gradient color modes are inspired by sunrise and sunset, designed to match the natural lighting of your campsite or bring a bit of nature into your home.


Please Note: GigaPower Battery required for use, not included.

Variant:
GigaPower Tabletop Lantern

item.title: GigaPower Battery
item.description:
The GigaPower battery is a high capacity mobile battery, designed to resemble a gas canister. The battery, designed in collaboration with Anker Japan, is durable, safe lithium ion phosphate, which offers a lifespan about four times longer than the average mobile battery.


Compatible Snow Peak lanterns can be attached to the USB-C port on the top, while other devices can be charged via the USB-A and USB-C ports on the back. The battery can be recharged through either USB-C port, with passthrough charging available when using the rear port.

Variant:
GigaPower Battery - 15000
GigaPower Battery - 30000
